meta.coord_order: [lat,lon] WGS84, 5 dp; g = array of paths
meta.where: VALDCO in metres, matched within +/-0.05 of 3.6, 5.4, 9.1, 18.2, 30.4, 36.5
meta.units: VALDCO is metres (S-57). ft = round(VALDCO/0.3048). US charts are fathom/foot based: 3.6 m = 12 ft (2 fm), 5.4 m = 18 ft (3 fm), 9.1 m = 30 ft (5 fm), 18.2 m = 60 ft (10 fm), 30.4 m = 100 ft, 36.5 m = 120 ft (20 fm).
meta.finding: Requested 10 ft (3.0 m) and 20 ft (6.1 m) contours do not exist in the Florida ENC data (no VALDCO 3.0 or 6.1 in coastal, approach or harbour). 100 ft (30.4 m) exists only as 20 approach-band segments, so 120 ft (36.5 m) is included as the nearest statewide deep contour. VALDCO values observed in coastal band: 0,1.8,5.4,9.1,18.2,36.5,54.8,73.1,91.4,182.8 and deeper; approach adds 0.9,2,3.6,5,7.3,10,10.9,15,20,27.4,30.4,60.9 etc.
meta.harbour_band: not included (mostly inshore 0.9 to 9.1 m); enc_harbour/104 has 25,090 contour lines in the bbox

meta.query: where=1=1; outFields=OBJECTID,SEAGRASS,METADATA,SOURCEDATE; outSR=4326; geometryPrecision=5; maxAllowableOffset=0.0005 deg (~50 m; small patches keep at least a triangle); paged 2000 by OBJECTID
meta.service_description: This polygon GIS data set represents a compilation of statewide seagrass data from various source agencies and scales. The data were mapped from sources ranging in date from 1987 to 2025. This dataset is complete as of data available to FWRI in August 2026. Not all data in this compilation are mapped from photography; some are the results of field measurements. See the "Sources" section for more information. The original source data sets were not all classified in the same manner; some used the Florida Land Use Cover and Forms Classification System (FLUCCS) codes 9113 for discontinuous seagrass and 9116 for continuous seagrass; some defined only presence and absence of seagrass, and some defined varying degrees of seagrass percent cover. In order to merge all of these data sources into one compilation data set, FWRI reclassified the various source data attribute schemes into two categories: "Continuous Seagrass" and "Patchy (Discontinuous) Seagrass". In areas where studies overlap, the most recent study where a given area has been interpreted is represented in this data set. This data set is not comparable to previous statewide data sets for time series studies - not all areas have been updated since the previous statewide compilation and some areas previously not mapped are now included. Please contact GIS Librarian to request the source data if you need to do a time series comparison. This data set has been updated in several areas from the previous compilation, including N
meta.row_format: [OBJECTID, SEAGRASS (C=Continuous, D=Discontinuous), source index into meta.sources (METADATA field), SOURCEDATE, rings as [[[lat,lon],...],...]]

meta.note: Seagrass maps compile surveys from 1987 to 2025 at mixed scales. Indicative only.
